mapper.select: SELECT sys99_print_id AS print_id , CASE WHEN sys99_company_id = 0 THEN '-' ELSE f_get_company_nm(sys99_company_id) END AS company_name , sys99_string01 AS string01 , sys99_string02 AS string02 , sys99_string03 AS string03 FROM sys99_print WHERE 1=1 AND sys99_group_id = #{groupId} AND sys99_window_class_nm = #{windowClassName} ORDER BY CASE WHEN sys99_company_id = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END , sys99_string01 COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" , sys99_company_id , sys99_string02 COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu"
